d:
What does a Sattvik diet actually mean? In Yoga, food is considered more than nourishment for the body. It is also traditionally associated with the qualities of the mind, including clarity, balance and steadiness.
You will learn:
1. How to build a balanced Sattvik plate with seasonal fruits and vegetables, leafy greens, whole grains, dals, pulses, nuts and dairy.
2. Why simple meals such as moong dal, chapati, curd, vegetable khichdi and moong dal chilla fit into a Sattvik diet.
3. The yogic understanding of the three gunas: Sattva, Rajas and Tamas.
